| Donald Trump's Justice Department just demanded the names, home addresses, personal emails, and phone numbers of thousands of people who helped run the 2020 election in Fulton County.
Everyone from election staff to poll workers to even bus drivers.
People who did the boring, necessary, deeply patriotic work that keeps our elections running are now being dragged into Trump's revenge campaign because he still cannot accept that he lost Georgia in 2020.
Trump has spent years making Fulton County a centerpiece of his election lies. His administration already seized Fulton election materials in January. Now they want personal information on the people who helped administer the election he lost.
No one should pretend this stops with Georgia.
This is how Trump and his allies try to poison elections before the votes are even cast: harass election workers, scare off volunteers, flood battlegrounds with lies, and create chaos they can exploit later.
That means Democrats cannot afford a quiet midterm electorate. We need turnout big enough in Georgia, North Carolina, the red-to-blue House districts, and every major battleground so Trump and his allies cannot spin the narrative, sue the system and personnel, intimidate voters and workers, or throw the entire election into confusion.

clean_body: Fulton County is fighting back. We need to as well. | | | | | == | Donald Trump's Justice Department just demanded the names, home addresses, personal emails, and phone numbers of thousands of people who helped run the 2020 election in Fulton County. Everyone from election staff to poll workers to even bus drivers. People who did the boring, necessary, deeply patriotic work that keeps our elections running are now being dragged into Trump's revenge campaign because he still cannot accept that he lost Georgia in 2020. Trump has spent years making Fulton County a centerpiece of his election lies. His administration already seized Fulton election materials in January. Now they want personal information on the people who helped administer the election he lost. No one should pretend this stops with Georgia. This is how Trump and his allies try to poison elections before the votes are even cast: harass election workers, scare off volunteers, flood battlegrounds with lies, and create chaos they can exploit later. That means Democrats cannot afford a quiet midterm electorate. [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In April 2025, Dustin Gonzalez stood before the Jefferson County school board and told them what had happened to his family. A school-appointed therapist in Lakewood, he said, had affirmed his daughter’s gender transition without his knowledge. His ex-wife initiated proceedings to take his visitation. A court-appointed investigator never accused him of abuse or harm. A judge ruled anyway that his inability to affirm was sufficient grounds to reduce his parenting time — and limited it to every other weekend, Gonzalez shared on X.
“It started in your schools,” Gonzalez told the board. “Your systems made it possible, and your silence made it personal. You never once thought, ‘Shouldn’t the father be involved, too.'” He described his objection. “I said, ‘I’m not ready to affirm this yet, that’s it.'” Of the school system, he told the board, “You stole my seat at the table, and you made decisions about my daughter without me. They didn’t even ask me. They replaced me.”
The document that explains how that sequence became possible was published a decade earlier by the National Education Association. The NEA describes itself as the nation’s largest professional employee organization, representing 3 million members.

body:
Let's celebrate and then get to work
Peter,
**Last night, it became official: I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Ohio.**
I’m grateful. Truly.
**[Will you help me mark this moment by splitting $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots to help us start the general election push strong and keep building our grassroots momentum?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/103468?refcode=em20260506-10392&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1&akid=10392%2E614464%2EC9e9EJ)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/103468?refcode=em20260506-10392&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10392%2E614464%2EC9e9EJ)**
**I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families.**
Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything.
Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in.
And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead.
But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted.
Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. Last night was an important step in that fight because it brought us _one step closer_ to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control.
**But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder.**
A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me.
**They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate.**
_The Cook Political Report_ now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together.
That’s why we set an ambitious goal: to raise $1 million by the end of the week so we can make critical investments across the state and reach voters in every corner of Ohio. **[So if you’re able, will you chip in $10, split between my campaign and Heartland Patriots, to help us start the general election strong and flip this seat?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/103468?refcode=em20260506-10392&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=10392%2E614464%2EC9e9EJ)**

name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: The rioters walked. The cop who stopped them didn't.
body:
Dear Patriot,
They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up.
They want to lock him away for using **non-lethal bean bag rounds** against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party.
I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed.
** [It has to stop — and I need your help to stop it.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=7c36cd67069f48ad901ac257f2873196&_e=bYSbSDovEJtDErtKU-qgH7_y0ibZ_N7kshZI_FAfgUi7qA-UyIeQXgo8rp7kVt1SdnJxM9NwpzTiSo8h0fTkG2TFqxWEQ82WHw0cO0XWGlO-_1pgt917UsYqmvCfgwBz85jY3wYybzxeMe22LWu7xlFB5_uP-wTStJzhbEk-AR80-99Dz46SUy1DPzn04QCcW3thwFfu2oPSsrVb4pf-9SHGH8rizxhv131zVYg9hlGOaUjy5Os0TJmmg12wkBcVQaQnlNSKwou00tVod5QVwiHjotcsiwnWpwbwOLl6wpqEvfzErVFfYmEbKsNF_tosFz4EZAZQhXffBIStcEP8FSjq6LWEsJ5vUxJmpykb-b6L2SZzZr-5Eq1eFQ9edDIQceBWCo3RM31dwhr5cfslrarKLHaRhgh5suOK3CEjTLznMI8sEp9ihbA9Khu4Xfjc) **
It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse.
On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused.
**Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway.**
Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife
When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence.
That's it. That's the "crime."

David Grusch served 14 years in the Air Force, reaching Major, including a combat tour in Afghanistan. Grusch also held senior intelligence roles at the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency and the National Reconnaissance Office and represented the latter on the Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) Task Force from 2019 until 2021. In 2022, he filed a whistleblower complaint deemed “credible and urgent.” In 2023, Grusch testified before Congress, alleging that elements of the U.S. government had thwarted Congressional oversight, withheld information from proper Executive Branch officials, and illegally concealed programs tied to the recovery and reverse engineering of craft of unknown, non-human origin.

https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/68714/images/IMG_4422.jpeg]
Peter,
We're in the throes of this unlawful special session, and I wanted to send a quick update between committee meetings and war room briefings.
We met on the House floor for the second time this morning, and the bills are currently being discussed in Senate Committees. The House committees began at 1:00pm. Of course, all of the House committees were specially created for this dog and pony show to ensure smooth passage of these new congressional districts.
Remember, Governor Lee called us back to the State Capitol to silence Black voices in Shelby County, because Donald Trump told him to do so. This whole special session is the type of nonsense you get when your governor is a weak-kneed sycophant. This is most certainly not how our form of democracy is supposed to work.
Now that social media is Republicans’ preferred medium for major policy announcements, the Republicans’ redrawn maps are now online. I’ve attached it at the top. Nothing says “transparency” quite like three or four men redrawing congressional maps behind closed doors with no public input, without any consideration of significant population shifts since 2020, and in such a short timeframe.
The Republican maps are startling but exactly what you’d expect from the type of people who’d do what they’re doing. These new congressional districts are about race, not fair representation. They are a result of one party abusing its power and blatantly disrespecting our Constitution and laws. They divide communities, silence Black voices, and combine dissimilar communities without any consideration of voting rights or voters’ best interests.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/68714/images/DSC01274.jpeg]

subject: When Montana needed someone to step up, Kurt did.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alme for Senate
body:
That tells you everything you need to know about Kurt Alme. |
---

Peter,

When Senator Daines decided to step down, Montana needed someone to step up.

_**Kurt Alme didn't hesitate.**_

After serving as U.S. Attorney, the job President Trump had nominated him to twice, he jumped into one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. No long deliberation. No waiting to see if the conditions were perfect. He saw that Montana needed him and he said yes.

That tells you everything you need to know about Kurt Alme.

I had the chance to sit down with Kurt recently, and I came away more convinced than ever that he is the right man for this seat. He has spent decades serving Montana as a prosecutor, a tax cutter, and a community servant. He has the record, the values, and the backbone to be an outstanding United States Senator.

He is also starting this race at a disadvantage. He entered late. The other side has had months to build their war chest. And we know from experience that Democrats will spend whatever it takes to try to flip Montana blue.

Kurt doesn't need a handout. He needs conservatives like you to stand behind him early, when it matters most.

Peter,

This week is Teacher Appreciation Week, and I want to start by saying _**thank you**_ to the teachers who show up every day for their students.

Teaching isn't easy. It takes patience, creativity, and a deep commitment to helping every child succeed. Our teachers do that work quietly and consistently— _often without the recognition or resources they deserve._

My mom was a public school teacher. I grew up seeing how much she gave to her students—the long hours, the care she poured into every lesson, and the way she showed up for kids who needed someone in their corner. That kind of dedication made an impression on me, and is a virtue I've worked hard to instill in my son.

I've seen firsthand how strong public schools can change a child's life. Supporting our teachers means supporting our students and our future. **But that hasn't stopped the Trump administration from going out of its way to gut the Department of Education.**

Trump's cuts to the Department of Education have meant fewer resources for our schools and fewer protections for students who need them most. That shows up in real ways. We see it in crowded classrooms, in overworked teachers, and in kids not getting the support they deserve. **We should be doing the opposite.** We should be making sure every teacher has what they need and every student has a fair shot.

This Teacher Appreciation Week, I'm asking you to do more than just say thank you.

| | Team Larsen is hitting the ground running for Filing Week, and our momentum is only getting stronger! **We're excited to share that over 60 current and former local elected officials across Northwest Washington have resoundingly endorsed Rick Larsen for his reelection to Congress.** We're grateful to have earned these endorsements. **As a former Snohomish County Councilmember and lifelong Snohomish County Democrat, Rick understands the importance of local elected officials' work firsthand.** **Their support is critical to ensuring Rick can continue listening to the needs of residents, experts, and local stakeholders and actually**** _deliver_****for Northwest Washington.** With their collaboration, Rick's brought millions of dollars home for infrastructure funding, good-paying jobs, and quality-of-life improvements for residents. Recently, that work accomplished:
* $33.99 million in funding to improve railways, reduce congestion, and move to greener transit options in Snohomish County alone!
* $27.12 million in funding for Skagit County to improve transit and build the Anacortes Community Event Center.
* $3.45 million for Island County to improve Oak Harbor, support the Boys & Girls Club Gymnasium, and invest in the recycling and reuse stations.
* $21.22 million in Whatcom County for greener hybrid buses, the FASST project, and to support Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services.
* $6.44 million in investments in San Juan County for trail improvements, investments in the Lopez Island Family Resource Center's Food Center, and replacing the Orcas Senior Center's roof.

clean_body: Current and former elected officials have resoundingly endorsed Rick’s reelection campaign. | | | | Team Larsen is hitting the ground running for Filing Week, and our momentum is only getting stronger! We're excited to share that over 60 current and former local elected officials across Northwest Washington have resoundingly endorsed Rick Larsen for his reelection to Congress. We're grateful to have earned these endorsements. As a former Snohomish County Councilmember and lifelong Snohomish County Democrat, Rick understands the importance of local elected officials' work firsthand. Their support is critical to ensuring Rick can continue listening to the needs of residents, experts, and local stakeholders and actually deliverfor Northwest Washington. With their collaboration, Rick's brought millions of dollars home for infrastructure funding, good-paying jobs, and quality-of-life improvements for residents. Recently, that work accomplished: $33.99 million in funding to improve railways, reduce congestion, and move to greener transit options in Snohomish County alone! $27.12 million in funding for Skagit County to improve transit and build the Anacortes Community Event Center. $3.45 million for Island County to improve Oak Harbor, support the Boys & Girls Club Gymnasium, and invest in the recycling and reuse stations. $21.22 million in Whatcom County for greener hybrid buses, the FASST project, and to support Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services. $6.44 million in investments in San Juan County for trail improvements, investments in the Lopez Island Family Resource Center's Food Center, and replacing the Orcas Senior Center's roof. Peter,
Today told you everything you need to know about May 19th.
This morning, Donald Trump ended the careers of five Republican state legislators -- destroyed them in primary elections -- for refusing to gerrymander their districts to rig the midterms. The message to every Republican official in America was unmistakable: do it, or you're next.
Georgia Supreme Court Justices Warren and Bethel already got that message. And they already answered it.
They voted to shield Donald Trump from criminal prosecution for trying to steal Georgia's 2020 election. They voted to uphold the abortion ban that is killing Georgia women. And with MAGA now raiding Fulton County election offices, seizing 2020 ballots, and demanding the names of poll workers -- we know exactly what Warren and Bethel will do when the next election dispute lands in front of them.
Indiana showed us today what happens when officials refuse to play along with MAGA.
Georgia on May 19th -- 13 days away -- we can show them what happens when they do.
Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin are running to replace them. A win sets up a full Georgia Supreme Court flip before the 2028 presidential election -- before MAGA's election machine needs that court to look the other way one more time.

Hi friend,

I’m Democratic Whip Katherine Clark, and my job comes down to one thing: the numbers. I count the votes. I know where we’re strong, where we’re vulnerable, and what it will take to win. Right now, the numbers are flashing a clear message — and that’s why I’m reaching out with a few you need to see today.

I need you to donate to Dr. Jasmeet Bains' campaign. Here’s why:

**$100 million**
That’s how much extreme national Republicans have raised to defeat us in the November elections. Trump’s super PAC already raked in over $100 million for the same goal.

**14 points**
That’s how much Democrats polled ahead of Republicans among registered voters when asked which party’s candidate they would be more likely to vote for. We have the votes, but we still need to make sure every single one of those voters shows up on election day.

**14 Republican Toss Up seats**
Political experts estimate that there are FOURTEEN House Republicans in Toss Up districts. Democrats only need to flip three seats to take back the House majority and CA-22 is one of our top pick-up opportunities.

Friend, Republicans are doubling down, but we still have a chance to stop them. The GOP is spending millions to unseat democratically elected representatives across the country, and only strong grassroots power will give us enough to fight back.

Friend, I started this campaign for Congress over a year ago to help bring an end to the toxic politics in Washington and advocate for common-sense policies like Medicare for All. **Because being a progressive fighter is just who I am.** Which is why when _The Sacramento Bee_ wrote about our race, they said:

**Friend, while a lot has changed in this race, my goals haven't.** Whether I'm running against an extremist in Kevin Kiley or an establishment Democrat, I'm going to continue the fight I started decades ago.
The fight that has led to me becoming an EPA worker, a Nevada County Supervisor, and now a candidate for Congress. **This is a fight for real change.** [**Friend, will you join me and support our campaign now that we're in the final month until the primary election? | | | Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.

[ ](https://heidihall4cong.com/l/YG3Mq0hy1poa)

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.

After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.

Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

name: David Hogg
subject: CA-07 is the moment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Mai Vang knows firsthand the issues her community struggles with. She’s running for Congress to be the fearless leader her district deserves.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260506-1&t=1&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)
Peter,
When **Mai Vang** was growing up in South Sacramento, her family didn’t have the luxury of waiting for someone else to fix things.
Her grandparents fled the war in Laos and grew crops in Elk Grove to support their family when they arrived in the US with nothing. Mai had to rely on food stamps and Medicaid to get by. And she attended the same public schools in the neighborhood she lives in today.
She watched her community — Hmong refugees, immigrant families, farmers, working people — get left behind by politicians who knew nothing about what their lives actually looked like or the struggles they faced.
So she decided to run for office and be the fearless fighter her district deserves.
**I’m proud to announce that Leaders We Deserve is endorsing Mai’s run for Congress in CA-07!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&refcode=em20260506-3446&t=2&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)
**[Before I go any further, Mai’s primary is June 2nd. The seat she’s fighting for is competitive, and she’s relying on grassroots support to reach as many voters as possible and win this. Can you split a $5 donation between Mai and Leaders We Deserve today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&refcode=em20260506-3446&amount=5&t=3&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&amount=5&refcode=em20260506-3446&t=4&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)**
**Mai came into politics through two decades of community organizing.** She’s been showing up for her neighbors long before there was ever an election to win. She did it because it needed to be done — that’s just who Mai is.
She co-founded Hmong Innovating Politics to organize parents to fight for their children’s educational future. On the Sacramento City Unified School Board, she authored and passed California’s first ever Safe Haven resolution, making sure that schools remain a safe place for students and families, regardless of their immigration status. Mai also helped lead the Sacramento Alliance for Vaccine Equity during the pandemic, making sure that it was multilingual so that immigrant families who spoke dozens of varying languages across the region still had access to those vaccines.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&refcode=em20260506-3446&t=5&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)
On the Sacramento City Council, where she’s served since 2020, Mai established the city’s first-ever Children’s Fund, dedicating over $8 million to supporting kids impacted by poverty, violence, and trauma. And when the Sacramento City Council voted on whether to give itself a pay raise, Mai declined because she knew how important it was to show her commitment to prioritizing her constituents when so many of them were struggling to make ends meet.
Just last week, she pushed the city council to ban ICE on city property. Because for Mai, this isn’t just a policy position. The people who will be harmed by opening the doors to ICE’s terror are her neighbors and family members. And she’s done everything in her power to protect them.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&refcode=em20260506-3446&t=6&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)
In Congress, Mai will champion Medicare for All, fight to abolish ICE, and push to build affordable housing for the working families getting priced out of Sacramento. She’ll prioritize solutions to the water shortages, extreme heat, and wildfires that are devastating rural farmers. And she’ll fight to tax corporations and billionaires who have been profiting off the suffering of working people, and invest those resources back into public schools, healthcare, and the climate resilience measures her district truly needs.
Mai is up against 81 year old incumbent Doris Matsui, who has held this seat for over 20 years. Doris has taken money from corporate PACs and has fallen completely out of touch with the residents of her district.
**CA-07 is hungry for something better — and Mai is exactly that.**
Mai doesn’t take a single dime from corporate PACs or special interests. Just like every Leaders We Deserve candidate, her campaign is sustained by grassroots donations from people like you who believe, like us, that Mai is the fighter this district has been waiting for.
**[Mai’s primary is June 2nd, and the clock is ticking. Will you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and Mai right now?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&refcode=em20260506-3446&amount=5&t=7&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260506_1_mai.6f0kW_&amount=5&refcode=em20260506-3446&t=26&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)**
Thank you,
David Hogg
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20260506-1&t=27&refcode2=3446_587540_5RqpDb&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=28&akid=3446%2E587540%2E5RqpDb)

# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1362%2E1086043%2Ed9r1RE)
Peter,
The Maryland Legislative Session is a 90-day sprint — and though it wasn’t easy, the General Assembly rose to the challenge. **[I’ll get into what we got done, but if you’re able to support our campaign for re-election right away, it will help continue our progress here in Maryland.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260506-1.CWRBXo&refcode=em-20260506-1&t=2&akid=1362%2E1086043%2Ed9r1RE)**
Here’s just some of what we got done:
**The DECADE Act** attracts, develops, and grows businesses here to make this Maryland’s decade.
**The Maryland Transit & Housing Opportunity Act** will develop state-owned land next to Metro and light rail stations, unlocking new housing and strengthening economic development.
**The Protection from Predatory Pricing Act** stops grocery stores and third-party delivery services from using personal data and automated systems to set individual prices for goods, protecting consumers.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Gas prices are skyrocketing, and Greg Abbott hasn’t said anything about it
body:
The last thing we need is more pain at the pump.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, earlier this year, Greg Abbott was bragging on social media about low gas prices.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260506_1_gas.iDh6xm&refcode=em20260506-1066&amount=5&t=1&akid=1066%2E299639%2ElcSZuL)
Now that gas prices are at an average of $4 a gallon, **Abbott hasn’t said a word.**
That is the pattern with Greg Abbott. When something looks good, he takes the credit. When he and his buddies cause harm, he stays silent or points the finger at someone else.
Meanwhile, Texans are already stretched thin.
I called on Greg Abbott to use his emergency powers to suspend the state gas tax two weeks ago. He could give Texans some immediate financial relief right now, yet he still hasn’t — and costs are only going up.
Families are dealing with high housing costs, high grocery bills, and high health care costs. The last thing we need is more pain at the pump because Greg Abbott would rather wait around for Washington to act than use the powers of his office to support working Texans.
Texans deserve better than leaders who only speak up when it benefits them. We deserve a governor who will tell the truth, stand up to injustice, and fight for working families.
That is why I’m running for governor. I’ve never backed down from a fight, and as governor, I will fight every single day for Texans, not billionaires and not any other politician.

Thank you,
Gina

subject: Registering Democrats in battleground states...

They have _$843.6 million_ on hand — money they can spend on reaching and registering even more Republican voters. subject: The largest defense budget in history:

Elfreth for Maryland
body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

Last week, Secretary Hegseth and General Caine came before the House Armed Services Committee to discuss the largest military budget in modern U.S. history. My approach was simple: ask the hard questions on behalf of my constituents, demand clear answers, and ensure our military leadership is held to the highest standards.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-May2026-FR-q2?&refcode=E29478-20260506-HesgethArmedS-Image-Military&amount=15 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-May2026-FR-q2?&refcode=E29478-20260506-HesgethArmedS-Image-Military&amount=15]

I’m not in Washington to trade partisan soundbites or go viral; I’m here to do the work. While others focused on political theater, I dug into the details, asking the where, what, and why of the 2027 budget to ensure our resources are actually going to the people who need them.

Ending Sexual Assault in the Military

We must drive these numbers down. I pressed the Secretary for the funding and a concrete commitment to hold leadership accountable for the safety of every person in uniform.

Aid to Ukraine

I asked for clarity on the $400 million Congress authorized for Ukraine. Secretary Hegseth admitted that the funding was finally released just this week — but only after public outcry and my pressing him in Committee the day after Senator Mitch McConnell's angry op-ed.

Global Security

I pressed General Caine for specific actions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. I made it clear that we need to evaluate all options at our disposal to resolve that conflict and keep the global economy moving.

I know that the comments and commitments made in these hearings have real-world consequences for families. At the end of the day, we aren’t just talking about budget line items; we’re making commitments to support the people who protect and serve.

I promise that I will never stop working to keep our servicemembers safe and our government accountable to the promises they’ve made.

Onward,

Sarah Elfreth

If you believe that Maryland’s Third District needs a pragmatic voice in Washington to ensure our servicemembers’ well-being is put above partisan politics, donate just $15 to keep Sarah Elfreth in Congress. name: Elizabeth
subject: Proud to stand with campus workers everywhere.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Guzman for Congress
clean_body: | | | — Last week, I was proud to stand at George Mason University with the United Campus Workers of Virginia in their fight for dignity and fair pay. But this isn’t just about one campus. This fight is being waged everywhere. Across the country, campus workers — adjuncts, staff, researchers — are organizing for fair pay, job security, and basic respect. And too often, they’re forced to fight institutions that rely on their labor but refuse to treat them with dignity. That has to change. As a representative in the Virginia House of Delegates, I was proud to vote for and pass the law that allowed public sector workers to unionize. I stand with campus workers, not just at George Mason, but across the U.S. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. I’m running for Congress to make sure unions and workers have someone in Washington who will fight for them. Because the fight for working people doesn’t stop at the factory floor. It’s in our schools, our hospitals, and our communities. We need leaders who will stand with workers, strengthen unions, and demand better. I will. Thank you for your support. In solidarity, Elizabeth | Democrat is running for Congress in Virginia's 7th District. She came to America as a single mother, becoming a union leader and one of the first Latinas in the Virginia General Assembly. She passed stronger gun safety laws, expanded collective bargaining rights and paid sick leave, and protected reproductive rights. To donate by check, send to: Guzman for Congress PO Box 74, Nokesville VA, 20182 \- \- Paid for by Guzman for Congress. Dear Patriot, They're trying to put an innocent cop in prison for **life**. Why? For defending himself against a fleeing suspect who dragged him with a car. I've been in law enforcement for decades. I've seen the system abused. But what is happening to Officer James Brennand of San Antonio, Texas makes my blood boil, and it should make yours boil too. On October 2nd, 2022, Officer James Brennand — a decorated Army veteran who swore an oath to protect his community — spotted a car he suspected was stolen outside a McDonald's in San Antonio. He called for backup. He approached the vehicle. He ordered the driver to step out. The driver's response? He threw the car into reverse and used it as a weapon. | [Defend Officer Brennand →](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=cc55afb20426485ebad30eee10fa99f9&_e=xuZGXcwU8JFAeEFaXNwrewGydSbXl177OQRi27hbFuM1UAWCkOyFaeJTbJmrhv51zd2MUE3ivGp86tFRswgUgZ_Nq_kU_XXXJ8NKkXSgTUfHOVOEj_VUemW-56t3vlBQ4geS3JuZGhfnXVRgwfKvArUw1-QdRe5C6Efn5kLulFag-zlvhM8L1uwVKAn5_tepnhtMQuKM3Vl9Lq21DGMCJPZoRU0aP-6hAcNQErkU1RZSmw0FisxfEXl9aPyeEvFHjKtaCZiBwT3FeVCScEA7sRYo4oP7FA50Gq_lpfH1mTuhB2rPGKh1n5o29G3RFCjjE3IiEbiKhnzHgC5FaU4VuyQUrBLFwDBsewHWgcmLn389T1lKQVO_NMvpahnEX3Jj4Gca1smplJSxVkYaMQ_OipuN_ZeLsJzVib9i6BT6LXiAjata40r5hMmu4SFXq-JR)

The car door slammed into Brennand. He was dragged. In that split second — outnumbered, without backup, in genuine danger — James did what every officer is trained to do. **He protected himself.**
The driver survived. The passenger was unharmed. And since that night, the driver has racked up four more arrests. **Four.**
While the man who attacked James faces no meaningful consequences, Officer Brennand has been stripped of his badge, his paycheck, and his future. A politically hungry District Attorney — more interested in headlines than justice — charged James with aggravated assault and deadly conduct. If convicted: **five years to life.**
Let that sink in. A man who served his country in the Army, who volunteered to protect the streets of San Antonio, who was dragged by a car in the line of duty — could die in prison.

| Peter,
Louisiana's ultra-MAGA Governor Jeff Landry thought he could pull off a coup.
He canceled our House elections by declaring a "state of emergency." Then he sat back and waited for disinformation to convince voters that ALL elections were canceled -- including our Senate race.
And he thought nobody would notice. He thought wrong.
My grandfather was a sharecropper who never got to see his vote truly count in Louisiana. My father fought his whole life for the right to participate fully in our democracy.
And I'll be damned if I'm going to let Jeff Landry and his MAGA cronies steal that right from his grandchildren.
What's happening right now is nothing short of historic:
Democratic turnout is SURGING. We're currently leading Republicans 56,000 to 53,000 in early voting.
If their intention was to silence our voices, they've only made Democrats in Louisiana MORE fired up.
Make no mistake about it: The MAGA Extremists just kicked the hornet's nest, and now we've got a clear shot at FLIPPING this state.
My name is Jamie Davis, I'm the Democrat running for US Senate in Louisiana. When we win, I will be Louisiana's first Black Senator since Reconstruction. Every single vote in this election matters -- not just for my race, but for the five MAGA-backed constitutional amendments on the ballot, for state and local races, and for sending a message that Louisiana rejects authoritarianism.
This is the front line of the fight against American fascism. What happens in Louisiana over the next three days will echo across the country.
MAGA thought they could rig the game by canceling elections. They thought Louisiana voters would just stay home, confused and defeated.
They were wrong about us. Dead wrong.

Jessica Machado discussed public records connected to Massachusetts shelter hotels, including incident reports involving domestic violence, child neglect, suicide and unattended children. She said those reports showed problems inside the hotels before residents were moved into communities where the same level of reporting may no longer exist. Additionally, Lewiston residents criticized city officials over shootings, rising property taxes and a lack of accountability from local leadership. Speakers at the council meeting said people are scared, tired of gunfire and frustrated that officials are not doing enough to address affordability and public safety.

# California Republican Party Endorses Magsig for Senate
---
|
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** May 6th, 2026Contact: nathan@nathanmagsig.com
---
| | | | | | **(Clovis, CA)** \- Today, Nathan Magsig announced the endorsement of the California Republican Party (CAGOP) for his campaign for State Senate.
Magsig expressed his appreciation for the endorsement, stating: “I’m honored to earn the support of the California Republican Party. Our campaign is focused on restoring common sense leadership to Sacramento by fighting for lower costs, safer communities, reliable water supplies, and greater local control for the Central Valley. I look forward to working alongside Republicans across California to bring practical solutions and strong representation to the State Senate.”
The endorsement from the California Republican Party adds to Magsig’s growing coalition of support from leaders and organizations throughout the Valley and across the state, reinforcing momentum behind his campaign and highlighting his commitment to fiscal responsibility, public safety, and policies that put working families first.

---
| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0d32ad8ea6ac4c7d9d0dc0a785a93e86&_e=NmdIYeZq6QqY6Q2vpuyQ19sZ18b2NursCRLxCJmGBhdMVlI2TX1TGV5WinXHVrotm9oFsknt2vhtNrTumL1ypAXJTuwgeGRm-O2xi4wkNU14YdNYCcb05YiRlVSl8khW1_Gl_2Qbqo4QizrfMu6XfOf4HyMzskhcoSRym49DXz6BKLK_Ue-XBecGB6sT7WccZtDrIRtoHuqr5iBQazQ4DO0YrV5nooGww5fQJaM_aa-YaF9xpHyF6lpPA83ioWLQILvF_U-5TbJunz04bZu9IGf9XK_m6pj-1ax6PYmjNhtYYy4OrVtDrHyWtH25_IQny7LT38hnNwzRWZyqfnpXrqkAybRjZPXAfLKFzmYVHjTLd6lr1far5xvOr0DUa5M9wq6IG2LtmnQcYhSvnbUGF2VS4MfFsdkjIQGvkDf68AF4kPyb2Vdh6W_AZOQaFAPba2AFWvWFdajTOZpw6_PQAbQyaEmaymE3c4MTapTpTeZ10zvIt8NdnsCDSEnk7wbi-Z7zGEttEq1u46FWjwDQT3SPUSrdQuQY0d1v4DHiy1lpOornHVKSstqC0bacBoi-XJkIDl4EDLXZGBhSLxh5IN0PNQ1Q5OfmB983LXLl8Ol57qEvAklchdJQ75W8_xlh7Avs33UZzn_IiXBBdyz20rMJ0peCfVbHv7LggqxIPKIqT_MyAachn2eq_ypgW1IJBUKPoxMpBaVqu9I0h572Rw%3D%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

* * *
**_A New Guarantee for Working Families_** Last month, we officially launched the [**Working Families Guarantee**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuTTj51y9UUqtBavPgj_RAvs6h9MstwOKgzA-thSqHxm11rxVki15lgwETjU4xxesBsKgBmmkFq-kasFhkNbH92ixVIJ9YvsUTWaZt1y6J6YsM8oG9vqyb0DbezqJS1ZyCCcGMogqNXCdyMy5sXFL_OFnEm27m_-IFt8rWzOkUil7Vht4QL7jdOK7--JXXBxHQtcQ7fD8qJCWlhslOrA3ZLNCGVVWI0Wcsaa4cLjrAa1Ho2VlCJ3kadk0PP8PiEkIZA/4qe/BYx7NbTTTcuThRnPN9ivlg/h0/h001.xA7IX7w5kE1h8pIv8ZwFhwC9WNUkrp1MSMlii90W8xs) — our bold new economic agenda for working people in the age of skyrocketing costs, billionaire greed, and AI-driven job loss. [ ](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuTTj51y9UUqtBavPgj_RAvs6h9MstwOKgzA-thSqHxm15OZeYLS07mr0X-y6tTgaP2tZGCYE62kX-7O7xJziNqznJ0IF_TY0Z-G7yLdGluk5V51Rj2XYBlHsCQks0ACJtNwmBm_3UD7e6mFinvPCkvoxAoBBtw6KHc5QVHKvbG3zT8P0IpVG2d_AsCtTC4FtBBLGtVnM_XLcCynK_UTpkxwidskmSEBykVdBhnoINDlMrURt1Xqzvg-9zsREoNlKcg/4qe/BYx7NbTTTcuThRnPN9ivlg/h1/h001.VTbO1K8-_pv4fLpwBOPMdtN5DQIlP62_vniSBqlQLAQ) [ ](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuTTj51y9UUqtBavPgj_RAvs6h9MstwOKgzA-thSqHxm1-WNU1swUpQR_HiAPWkVjoGifruhuEnNUZuwRHtV_aUAOJBROHfdkpZ6eE8wGZ511X7y4VCCDQhJFrApQPgUZKNpkJuu85OOSyLWLBoF4oR2Ya4EDlHjj3zdqZKj5ghPmsTK9q_lihu9kTbXbLqmKmASt7oJpGmMKzE0w0jcv2yH3prYmtN4dQitPKNFCQV15MNHM7xmVTrbPtyvuHYJA3A/4qe/BYx7NbTTTcuThRnPN9ivlg/h2/h001.eat6vLYR5459S68PHAzcisS4WAUXt36D23Ny_jhb5Aw) At a Capitol Hill launch event, Working Families champions including Rep. Analilia Mejia To You_** Former New Jersey Working Families Party State Director and WFP National Executive Committee member **Analilia Mejia** was officially sworn in to Congress in April as the U.S. Representative for New Jersey’s 11th District — and she wasted absolutely no time getting to work. [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvlwhslwHzsYo7bshL1ic1bNIqrL-WigGpiYZO44CjU0zzMW5zBB-aeCMUhH5-SzhQYna0g75jeCVgvZCvn2FGlnCTQYqDHnUdzJBRQkJ-hObl0OgQ_4gcU468WFIKX02mjX2Fx9oJEZ3Mj4tgrokU87x0KUlcR_gGHp9cVL3OWH12L5IgVEH14VXi1Z0P70IZ-Y_HB6R3LG5fctZn0hjHfEQaWl5hukwpR7e9AlBvxTCRlQX-FGmeTT-G8hkcNdw-RuYFLXmdi2qNZDkvr3hls7OjraoUgkf8xmLOIAJbwDHBupvpAvTt0No4g1rel67iZw0de763Hx3OwI4E-QCbXqOOmFMLXtsiaND8CqEpvdw/4qe/BYx7NbTTTcuThRnPN9ivlg/h9/h001.w9dmOHllCScbIaGe5NB-MNgaejp7YBuY2RLvnFGiZWY) Analilia is already serving on the Committee on Homeland Security, where she’s fighting to hold federal agents accountable for carrying out the Trump administration’s brutal immigration agenda. She also introduced her very first bill alongside fellow WFP champion Rep. Analilia’s victory is a huge win for working people and a reminder that bold progressive leadership can win, even while taking on billionaires, corporate power, and the pro-war establishment head on. **And because she won in a special election, the fight isn’t over yet: Analilia is now running for a full term in New Jersey’s June 2nd Democratic primary.** [**Split a donation now to support Analilia Mejía — a longtime organizer and New Jersey Working Families Party leader — so we can help her secure a full term in Congress this June and keep winning all the way through November.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvlwhslwHzsYo7bshL1ic1bNIqrL-WigGpiYZO44CjU0zzMW5zBB-aeCMUhH5-SzhQYna0g75jeCVgvZCvn2FGlReIOf3mRVK4ldAcEEIVgOJLcrXGCAps2Q24o9YcGfh2m9DJVRXErm6krSgoJ4K_F3Nw43L_G2ExWt9diN9c-u4d-ZcYwTAorvj0d9pQxwSZQsLYdIqDI5qlprhY1tJHfhaurYXAPB-xDLMdEKle6Zg1k7vDTU5e7xpDj-bFg4EKh07p6rCr26p1aTCv2S0a0oxx1aZDS9YpXIjSWRKQ3lxiolU2hug7-MeN1Rg6MAzQedfCH0-_jQzsrt1DyhfcplSlTWtJ8JrJr4_iw70gUow/4qe/BYx7NbTTTcuThRnPN9ivlg/h10/h001.W_Dg9Og_529fkA9qEVNxOIrz5-9Dw-qXcJwsZqoLuFo)

clean_body: | | | Peter, Across the country, Working Families champions are taking on billionaire money, corporate political machines, and the far right — and we’re winning. This past month alone, we launched the Working Families Guarantee, celebrated major victories, passed bold legislation, and geared up for some of the biggest races of 2026. Here’s some of what we’ve been up to: A New Guarantee for Working Families Last month, we officially launched the — our bold new economic agenda for working people in the age of skyrocketing costs, billionaire greed, and AI-driven job loss. At a Capitol Hill launch event, Working Families champions including Rep. Pramila Jayapal, Rep. Delia Ramirez, CPC Chair Rep. Greg Casar, and newly-elected Rep. Analilia Mejia rallied behind the Guarantee, while WFP candidates across the country pledged their support heading into the 2026 midterms. The message is simple: instead of spending billions on ICE raids, tax cuts for the rich, and endless war, our government should guarantee affordable housing, healthcare, childcare, paid leave, and good-paying jobs for working people. And the momentum is growing fast. National outlets like , , , and all covered the launch — with putting it best: “You don't get what you don't fight for. I'm all in for the Working Families Guarantee.” That’s U.S. Rep. Analilia Mejia To You Former New Jersey Working Families Party State Director and WFP National Executive Committee member Analilia Mejia was officially sworn in to Congress in April as the U.S. Representative for New Jersey’s 11th District — and she wasted absolutely no time getting to work. Analilia is already serving on the Committee on Homeland Security, where she’s fighting to hold federal agents accountable for carrying out the Trump administration’s brutal immigration agenda. She also introduced her very first bill alongside fellow WFP champion Rep. Delia Ramirez to raise the federal minimum wage to $25 an hour — building on the work she helped lead to win a $15 minimum wage in New Jersey. Analilia’s victory is a huge win for working people and a reminder that bold progressive leadership can win, even while taking on billionaires, corporate power, and the pro-war establishment head on. And because she won in a special election, the fight isn’t over yet: Analilia is now running for a full term in New Jersey’s June 2nd Democratic primary. Real Results for Philadelphia Working Families Philadelphia Working Families Party City Councilmembers Kendra Brooks and Nicolas O’Rourke are showing what governing for working people actually looks like. This month, Kendra and fellow Councilmember Rue Landau passed to push back against Trump and Stephen Miller’s immigration crackdown — including banning cooperation agreements with ICE, preventing federal agents from using city property without a judicial warrant, and strengthening protections against discrimination based on immigration status. Meanwhile, Nicolas advanced that expands protections against unfair evictions, strengthens rental inspections, and explicitly guarantees tenants the right to organize. Turns out when you elect Working Families champions, working families actually win. Voting for Musk’s Payday Doesn’t Pay Off The Delaware Working Families Party is backing primary challengers against five incumbent Democrats who voted for the so-called “billionaires bill” that handed Elon Musk a massive last year. The challengers — running in four State House races and two State Senate races — are taking on the same kind of corporate Democratic leadership Delaware WFP has already beaten before. In recent years, the party helped unseat both the incumbent Speaker of the House and the House Majority Whip. And while corporate Democrats were busy doing favors for billionaires, Working Families champions in Delaware were winning universal free school meals, earned sick time, stronger renter protections, and local hiring agreements that create jobs for working people. Because working people are tired of politicians treating billionaires like the only constituency that matters. The Billionaires Are Getting Nervous If it feels like the political establishment and billionaire donors are throwing everything they can at Working Families candidates right now... it’s because they are. In California , the WFP champion Randy Villegas in one of the most competitive congressional races of 2026 — because they know he’s not the kind of candidate who will fall in line for corporate donors. Randy, the son of Mexican immigrants, has built major momentum in CA-22 without taking corporate money, while establishment-backed opponents rake in donations from the same wealthy interests funding Republicans. And in Maine , are already dumping millions to attack WFP Senate candidate Graham Platner as he takes on Susan Collins. One super PAC launched a $2 million ad buy against Graham, while another Republican group with more than $42 million cash on hand threatened that he “will no longer be able to live in the state” after the race. Why are they panicking? Because candidates like Randy and Graham are proving that you can run on guaranteed housing, universal healthcare, taxing billionaires, and standing up to corporate power — and actually build a winning movement around it. The good news? We’ve seen this movie before. And more and more voters are rejecting the billionaire-backed consultants, lobbyists, and political machines trying to stop working class candidates from winning power. Midterm Season Is Heating Up The 2026 midterms are already delivering big wins for Working Families champions — and we’re only getting started. In less than two weeks, Pennsylvania voters head to the polls, where WFP is backing congressional candidates including firefighter Bob Brooks and Northwest Philadelphia State Representative Chris Rabb. And that’s just one of many key primaries coming up in the weeks ahead. Across the country, Working Families Party endorsements are stacking up fast — with running for office at every level of government on platforms centered around affordability, healthcare, public education, labor rights, immigrant justice, and taking power back from billionaires and corporate lobbyists. And trust us: the billionaire class has noticed. clean_body: The biggest National Memorial Day Parade yet| | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. **Last night, it became official: I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Ohio.** I’m grateful. Truly. **[Will you help me mark this moment by splitting $25 between my campaign and Zoe Lofgren to help us start the general election push strong and keep building our grassroots momentum?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130884639/619245235/2107384367?amount=25&refcode=EM_ALL_ZOL_FRS_1_2026-05-06_SBN_FTS_ES-47723&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTYwNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDg2M2I4YS05NTQ5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OfumooS_jeZuDCqD8jsRa3UWU3FdUfzg2r7sPP60LBA=)**

---
**I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families.****

**Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything. Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in. And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead. But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted. Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. Last night was an important step in that fight because it brought us _one step closer_ to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control _._ **But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder.****

**A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me. **They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate.****

**_The Cook Political Report_ now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together. That’s why we set an ambitious goal: to raise $1 million by the end of the week so we can make critical investments across the state and reach voters in every corner of Ohio. body:
From the rear steps of Lincoln’s memorial you can look directly across the Arlington Memorial Bridge to the graves of hundreds of thousands of men and women who fought and died so our democracy would survive.
#
Peter, take a look at this.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260506-1-60&refcode2=35133.3013755.lqAMoE&akid=35133%2E3013755%2ElqAMoE)
That’s a mockup of the “triumphal” arch Trump wants to build in front of Arlington National Cemetery.
If you’ve ever been to Washington, you know our monuments and sacred spaces have been plotted and built over generations by thoughtful stewards of America’s heritage and history. One of the most poignant examples of that is the space between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260506-1-60&refcode2=35133.3013755.lqAMoE&akid=35133%2E3013755%2ElqAMoE)
From the rear steps of Lincoln’s memorial you can look directly across the Arlington Memorial Bridge to the graves of hundreds of thousands of men and women who fought and died so our democracy would survive. Donald Trump wants to block that view with a 250-foot-tall arch. A golden monument to himself. The Arc de Trump.
Just one more insult from the man who trampled the graves of the fallen at Arlington for a campaign photo op. The same man who called the fallen “suckers” and “losers,” and refused to honor them because of a little rain. **Trump dodged the draft five times, and now he wants to force our honored dead into his shadow.**
This has gone on long enough, and we must put an end to it.
[**Peter, we’re writing to ask you to voice your opposition. Veterans are already suing to block this arch, and we need to build a loud, nationwide opposition to support them. Add your name here and say no to the Arc de Trump.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260506-1-60&refcode2=35133.3013755.lqAMoE&akid=35133%2E3013755%2ElqAMoE)

body:
I went to court in February over this, and the judge upheld our Constitution and blocked what Hegseth was trying to do. This whole thing should’ve ended there.
#

Hey Folks,
As you might remember, I filed a federal lawsuit against Pete Hegseth and the Trump Administration in January.
It’s been a little while, so I want to get you back up to speed on where that legal action stands.
Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth sent a chilling message to every retired member of the military: If you speak out and say something that the President or the Secretary of Defense does not like, you could be censured, threatened with a reduction in retirement grade, or even prosecuted.
It was a blatant abuse of power, an attempt to silence the voices that they find inconvenient — even when speech is protected by the First Amendment.
I went to court in February over this, and the judge upheld our Constitution and blocked what Hegseth was trying to do. This whole thing should’ve ended there, but Hegseth appealed the decision almost immediately. The hearing for that appeal is Thursday — tomorrow.
Through this whole process, I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do.
But your help is about more than that. It's about sending a message to Trump and Hegseth that the American people won’t stand by while our Constitutional rights are attacked.
We’re winning this, and we’ll get to the other side the same way we always do: Together.
Now, this is the part where I ask for your help:
[**If standing up for the Constitution is important to you, please rush a $3 contribution to my campaign. Our average donation online is around $22. Many give more, some give less. #

**Last night, it became official: I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Ohio.**

I’m grateful. Truly.

**[Will you help me mark this moment by splitting a donation between my campaign and Robert Garcia to help us start the general election push strong and keep building our grassroots momentum?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130885383/619247945/417329874?refcode=260506em&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjg4MjBjYS05NjQ5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r9QCmPMBf2diGYGpiElgTOhHZad54tR6gedHKTV-tac=)**

**I came off the sidelines for one reason: working families.**

Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything.

Americans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in.

And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many folks are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead.

But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted.

America deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. Last night was an important step in that fight because it brought us one step closer to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control.

**But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder.**

A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me.

**They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate.**

_The Cook Political Report_ now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together.

That’s why we set an ambitious goal: to raise $1 million by the end of the week so we can make critical investments across the state and reach voters in every corner of Ohio.

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMay 6, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**Retired U.S. Army Colonel Rob Maness Endorses Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate** _Endorsement highlights growing support for Trump-endorsed conservative across Louisiana_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, announced that retired U.S. Air Force Colonel Rob Maness has endorsed her campaign for the United States Senate.
Maness, a retired military officer and longtime conservative voice in Louisiana, praised Letlow’s conservative record, support for President Trump, and commitment to fighting for Louisiana families.
_“After watching the debate Julia is the Fighter America needs in the US Senate,”_ **said Maness.** “ _That’s why President Donald Trump endorsed her, she’s a fighter and the debate proved it! I am PROUD to endorse Representative Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate in Louisiana.”_
Letlow thanked Maness for his endorsement and years of service to the country and the state.
_“I’m honored to have Colonel Rob Maness’ support,”_ **said Rep. Letlow.** _“Rob has spent his life serving our country and fighting for conservative values, and I’m grateful to have him standing with our campaign. Louisiana deserves a senator who will stand with President Trump, fight for our families, secure our border, protect our values, and always put our state first. That’s exactly what I will do in the Senate.”_
Rep. Letlow, a Monroe native, mother of two, and former educator, has represented Louisiana’s 5th Congressional District since 2021 and currently serves on the House Appropriations Committee and the Committee on Education and the Workforce. She is running as the Trump-endorsed conservative in the race, emphasizing her record of delivering for Louisiana and her commitment to the America First agenda.
This endorsement builds on the campaign’s growing momentum as it continues to earn support from conservative leaders, grassroots organizations, and voters across Louisiana ahead of the May 16 Republican primary.

subject: The real frontline isn’t where you think
body:
It’s not too late — but it’s close | | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3b4c2bf4f21d4ca2919df301998e0262&_e=cvKyr7P31VvkZXUdQf6s8I5VfmpZBJ7Dz72xeSZhs9okj5vZi19wz56j9JlaXJU3vjtIRDUeSSeX9Am_TV0eLa9y1gZRlJ15J8OqGE0rE72D86ps1yM2ycudmPk9XtlbnKu-5aTe4E1WmFWOB_lH5C9M0otKkCNTXoZXUepGaiNxs-AScS-XcZz38x-ksvlA8lG9_3VVsaiKSfpAEsnpZhPop3ttElM826ZB9YQ62FV3jICtvnmsgdTtPiX6Je3iLgmsKj-C2FOOEyKX__excFDeSsShGarn8i4PYBIpNtX_lj9m-l1ash-cUBYUCIOR9vQ-7wYPqChBakWdkXTZsxRqdN135uec2FYmmN1ltH2TKZpkepV-5Lktg80EzXtR8s6Cmvw3KkPFjYvgyQ0CfKextA_pAUfhNEnr1BP_tIKhaxU8t93ibi1peATrSA1Z9al-7HomI7zE1kHCE8vN1Dpg7RKN23wea-VyjY-zg22-iH743vyIGCUiQQw6ifqOlIYQhAO5xl0IpE6TMjqk1xdwsdIkRqZ0LUGt2Fm7b-ervAaZxK-3x-ilDogTYXBcDj_L5EPJfn6c_K7Iizjl0H0742DuvYFClz5kfLOVcJiTaida4FbDrGQcIWmzlQV2MZDqTlEDrM8SXmEEReDvwQd9oVKIysheiA5P4z_zkbEhLyy-NJ8O1DLRIYlQtNPDf0GGTyxW1BABSGhaebbxIw%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3b4c2bf4f21d4ca2919df301998e0262&_e=cvKyr7P31VvkZXUdQf6s8I5VfmpZBJ7Dz72xeSZhs9okj5vZi19wz56j9JlaXJU3vjtIRDUeSSeX9Am_TV0eLa9y1gZRlJ15J8OqGE0rE72D86ps1yM2ycudmPk9XtlbnKu-5aTe4E1WmFWOB_lH5C9M0otKkCNTXoZXUepGaiNxs-AScS-XcZz38x-ksvlA8lG9_3VVsaiKSfpAEsnpZhPop3ttElM826ZB9YQ62FV3jICtvnmsgdTtPiX6Je3iop3LZdwVUWBQH3Q12X5fJDzRqL89NoK_vcB_8vCAas_PwsHFF2fzruOZlj1PE82HullwtYM83g4F-sW1lfhiAR32aYlau1j0p3lHP3bVCAUrQ5qv38rRPIffzi6fSGptr8Aj83hXah1ATtg0WscPVOpzhpMg1P3DoAeQTuL5SOZie1exLJ4PE0kioK7hWt8UxZbISM0uxGQwYJWny8j9jo7v4w1bCAQhmk-DDNI8qD_APIZmN5Ia9_7qakS64bRWKM3Kf8TQESXfwr_ewOFIFM1n7Pj3NGdOdyu4w4d39T1GND9SDP_-PLPJqflp1mpUrkSJhoRx2L_GYaDm_5qkB2kA9MbIW5EHuESTO_KF2FDSYaITQ3znwYm8O3EDud8lvPhusGPzSbZSAnIK8LDElhzP7EYkIMCvVIvp4gi-DZYBptmoYyzgXCGlwpQwElrgRKv_YxFA2KedN4L80RZuhA%3D%3D)
---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Fellow Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

clean_body: It’s not too late — but it’s close | | | | | Fellow Patriot, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Fellow Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Fellow Patriot... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Fellow Patriot -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. clean_body: This is my hail Mary... | Dear Peter, This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written. I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 80-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right. I’ve taken on mobsters. I’ve faced terrorists. I’ve battled corruption. I’ve been through it all. Or so I thought... ...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a federal pardon in state court. They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses! No pardon. No protection. No cavalry coming over the hill. But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful force absolutely can: THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me: the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like YOU. My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — — calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES. Thank you and God bless you, Rudy Giuliani Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust |
